grammar.pattern: 从 + 时间 / 处所 + 起
grammar.purpose: Mark the beginning of an interval
grammar.explanation: 从下周起 sets next week as the starting point, not the end. 从这里起 can mark a starting location. A later duration or endpoint must be stated separately. 从…起 does not assert that a plan has already begun.

examples.py: cóng xià zhōu qǐ , měi zhōu liàn liǎng cì .
examples.en: Starting next week, practise twice a week.

examples.zh: 从今天起，先记录实际练习时间。
examples.py: cóng jīn tiān qǐ , xiān jì lù shí jì liàn xí shí jiān .
examples.en: Starting today, record actual practice time first.

examples.py: cóng zhè lǐ qǐ , yán zhè tiáo lù zǒu .

commonMistakes.wrong: 从下周起，就是下周结束。
commonMistakes.right: 从下周起，表示下周开始。
commonMistakes.why: 起 marks the beginning, not an endpoint.

grammar.pattern: 结束事件 + 时量 + 了
grammar.purpose: Measure elapsed time since an event ended
grammar.explanation: 她离开这里三天了 measures three days since departure; 电影结束十分钟了 measures ten minutes since the end. In contrast 她走了三天 can describe three days spent travelling. Identify the event’s end and the current reference point; a time amount alone does not decide continued action versus elapsed time.

examples.py: tā lí kāi zhè lǐ sān tiān le .
examples.en: It has been three days since she left here.

examples.py: diàn yǐng jié shù shí fēn zhōng le .
examples.en: The film ended ten minutes ago.

examples.zh: 她下课半小时了，还在门口等。
examples.py: tā xià kè bàn xiǎo shí le , hái zài mén kǒu děng .
examples.en: Class ended for her half an hour ago; she is still waiting at the doorway.

commonMistakes.wrong: 电影结束十分钟了，就是电影放了十分钟。
commonMistakes.right: 电影结束十分钟了，指结束以后过了十分钟。
commonMistakes.why: Elapsed time after ending differs from the duration of the screening.

lines.zh: 你报的初级游泳课，什么时候开始？
lines.py: nǐ bào de chū jí yóu yǒng kè , shén me shí hou kāi shǐ ?
lines.en: When does your beginner swimming course start?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 从下周起，周二和周四晚上六点半上课。
lines.py: cóng xià zhōu qǐ , zhōu èr hé zhōu sì wǎn shang liù diǎn bàn shàng kè .
lines.en: From next week, Tuesdays and Thursdays at six thirty in the evening.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 下班以后赶得上吗？
lines.py: xià bān yǐ hòu gǎn de shàng ma ?
lines.en: Can you get there after work?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 我五点半下班，坐车二十分钟，应该来得及。
lines.py: wǒ wǔ diǎn bàn xià bān , zuò chē èr shí fēn zhōng , yīng gāi lái de jí .
lines.en: I finish at five thirty. The bus takes twenty minutes, so I should have time.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 我也想报。我从初中以后就很少游泳了。
lines.py: wǒ yě xiǎng bào . wǒ cóng chū zhōng yǐ hòu jiù hěn shǎo yóu yǒng le .
lines.en: I'd like to join too. I haven't swum much since junior secondary school.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 那我们一起。教练说第一节不用游很远，先慢慢来。
lines.py: nà wǒ men yì qǐ . jiào liàn shuō dì yī jié bù yòng yóu hěn yuǎn , xiān màn màn lái .
lines.en: Let's go together. The coach says we won't swim far in the first class; we can take it slowly.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 几点到比较好？
lines.py: jǐ diǎn dào bǐ jiào hǎo ?
lines.en: What time should we arrive?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 六点十五分吧，还要换衣服。
lines.py: liù diǎn shí wǔ fēn ba , hái yào huàn yī fú .
lines.en: Six fifteen. We need time to change.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 好。你第一次别等我到了才进去。
lines.py: hǎo . nǐ dì yī cì bié děng wǒ dào le cái jìn qù .
lines.en: Good. Don't wait for me before going in the first time.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 为什么？你要迟到？
lines.py: wèi shén me ? nǐ yào chí dào ?
lines.en: Why? Will you be late?
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 不是，我怕你在门口等，我在里面等，两个人就这么一直等着。
lines.py: bù shì , wǒ pà nǐ zài mén kǒu děng , wǒ zài lǐ miàn děng , liǎng gè rén jiù zhè me yì zhí děng zhe .
lines.en: No. You might wait outside while I wait inside, and we'd both just keep waiting.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 那就在门口见，到了先发消息。
lines.py: nà jiù zài mén kǒu jiàn , dào le xiān fā xiāo xī .
lines.en: Let's meet at the entrance, then. Send a message when you arrive.
lines.speaker: b

reading.title: One clock, several meanings
reading.blurb: An original scene written for this course.
reading.purpose: Follow the situation, the problem and what happens next.

lines.zh: 从下周起，我周二和周四晚上要去上初级游泳课。陈宇也报了，我们约好第一天六点十五分在门口见。
lines.py: cóng xià zhōu qǐ , wǒ zhōu èr hé zhōu sì wǎn shang yào qù shàng chū jí yóu yǒng kè . chén yǔ yě bào le , wǒ men yuē hǎo dì yī tiān liù diǎn shí wǔ fēn zài mén kǒu jiàn .
lines.en: My beginner swimming classes were due to start the following week, on Tuesday and Thursday evenings. Chen Yu joined too. We arranged to meet at the entrance at six fifteen on the first day.

lines.zh: 周二我五点半下班，坐车去游泳馆。下车时才六点，我慢慢走到门口，先发消息说自己已经到了。
lines.py: zhōu èr wǒ wǔ diǎn bàn xià bān , zuò chē qù yóu yǒng guǎn . xià chē shí cái liù diǎn , wǒ màn màn zǒu dào mén kǒu , xiān fā xiāo xī shuō zì jǐ yǐ jīng dào le .
lines.en: On Tuesday I finished work at five thirty and took a bus to the pool. It was only six when I got off, so I walked slowly to the entrance and messaged that I had arrived.

lines.zh: 陈宇说还要等十分钟，我就坐在门边的椅子上。等他到了，两个人一起进去换衣服，没有一个人在里面、一个人在外面互相等待。
lines.py: chén yǔ shuō hái yào děng shí fēn zhōng , wǒ jiù zuò zài mén biān de yǐ zi shàng . děng tā dào le , liǎng gè rén yì qǐ jìn qù huàn yī fú , méi yǒu yī gè rén zài lǐ miàn , yī gè rén zài wài miàn hù xiāng děng dài .
lines.en: Chen Yu needed another ten minutes, so I sat on a chair by the door. We went in and changed together when he arrived, rather than waiting for each other in different places.

lines.zh: 教练先让我们在水边坐好，说第一节主要练习怎么在水里放松。我从初中以后很少游泳，刚下水有点紧张，他让我先扶着池边试。
lines.py: jiào liàn xiān ràng wǒ men zài shuǐ biān zuò hǎo , shuō dì yī jié zhǔ yào liàn xí zěn me zài shuǐ lǐ fàng sōng . wǒ cóng chū zhōng yǐ hòu hěn shǎo yóu yǒng , gāng xià shuǐ yǒu diǎn jǐn zhāng , tā ràng wǒ xiān fú zhe chí biān shì .
lines.en: The coach sat us by the water and said the first lesson focused on relaxing in it. I had rarely swum since junior secondary school and felt nervous getting in. He suggested holding the side first.

lines.zh: 下课十分钟了，我们还坐在门口喝水。陈宇问累不累，我说还好，只是脚一离开地面，就总想站起来。他说自己也是，下次再慢慢试。
lines.py: xià kè shí fēn zhōng le , wǒ men hái zuò zài mén kǒu hē shuǐ . chén yǔ wèn lèi bù lèi , wǒ shuō hái hǎo , zhǐ shì jiǎo yī lí kāi dì miàn , jiù zǒng xiǎng zhàn qǐ lái . tā shuō zì jǐ yě shì , xià cì zài màn màn shì .
lines.en: Ten minutes after class we were still drinking water outside. Chen Yu asked if I was tired. I was all right, but whenever my feet left the ground I wanted to stand up. He felt the same; we could try again gradually next time.

lines.zh: 回家路上，我们约好周四还是六点十五分见。我把时间写进手机，又把游泳的东西放回包里，这次不用到出门前才找。
lines.py: huí jiā lù shàng , wǒ men yuē hǎo zhōu sì hái shi liù diǎn shí wǔ fēn jiàn . wǒ bǎ shí jiān xiě jìn shǒu jī , yòu bǎ yóu yǒng de dōng xi fàng huí bāo lǐ , zhè cì bù yòng dào chū mén qián cái zhǎo .
lines.en: On the way home we arranged the same six-fifteen meeting for Thursday. I put the time in my phone and the swimming things back in my bag, so I would not have to search just before leaving.

extraReadings.titleZh: 从下周起 · 词语练习

lines.zh: 电影马上开始了。
lines.py: diàn yǐng mǎ shàng kāi shǐ le .
lines.en: The film is about to start.

lines.zh: 我们从简单的地方开始吧。
lines.py: wǒ men cóng jiǎn dān de dì fāng kāi shǐ ba .
lines.en: Let's start with the easy part.

lines.zh: 上周以来，他每天都来。
lines.py: shàng zhōu yǐ lái , tā měi tiān dōu lái .
lines.en: He has come every day since last week.

lines.zh: 毕业以来，我很少见到她。
lines.py: bì yè yǐ lái , wǒ hěn shǎo jiàn dào tā .
lines.en: I've rarely seen her since graduation.

lines.zh: 他后年准备回家工作。
lines.py: tā hòu nián zhǔn bèi huí jiā gōng zuò .
lines.en: He plans to work back home the year after next.

lines.zh: 我们约好后年再一起旅行。
lines.py: wǒ men yuē hǎo hòu nián zài yì qǐ lǚ xíng .
lines.en: We agreed to travel together again the year after next.

lines.zh: 教练让我们先休息一下。
lines.py: jiào liàn ràng wǒ men xiān xiū xī yī xià .
lines.en: The coach asked us to rest first.

lines.zh: 我想问教练一个问题。
lines.py: wǒ xiǎng wèn jiào liàn yī gè wèn tí .
lines.en: I'd like to ask the coach a question.

lines.zh: 月初我就交了房租。
lines.py: yuè chū wǒ jiù jiāo le fáng zū .
lines.en: I paid rent at the start of the month.

lines.zh: 年初她换了一份工作。
lines.py: nián chū tā huàn le yī fèn gōng zuò .
lines.en: She changed jobs at the beginning of the year.

lines.zh: 他们初步决定在周六见面。
lines.py: tā men chū bù jué dìng zài zhōu liù jiàn miàn .
lines.en: They tentatively decided to meet on Saturday.

lines.zh: 这是初步计划，还可以改。
lines.py: zhè shì chū bù jì huà , hái kě yǐ gǎi .
lines.en: This is a preliminary plan and can still change.

lines.zh: 她报名参加了初级课程。
lines.py: tā bào míng cān jiā le chū jí kè chéng .
lines.en: She enrolled in a beginner course.

lines.zh: 这本书适合初级学生。
lines.py: zhè běn shū shì hé chū jí xué sheng .
lines.en: This book suits beginner students.

lines.zh: 我们是初中同学。
lines.py: wǒ men shì chū zhōng tóng xué .
lines.en: We were classmates in junior secondary school.

lines.zh: 他从初中起就喜欢画画。
lines.py: tā cóng chū zhōng qǐ jiù xǐ huān huà huà .
lines.en: He has liked drawing since junior secondary school.

lines.zh: 我等了将近半小时。
lines.py: wǒ děng le jiāng jìn bàn xiǎo shí .
lines.en: I've waited nearly half an hour.

lines.zh: 来参加的人将近五十个。
lines.py: lái cān jiā de rén jiāng jìn wǔ shí gè .
lines.en: Almost fifty people attended.

lines.zh: 我们已经接近车站了。
lines.py: wǒ men yǐ jīng jiē jìn chē zhàn le .
lines.en: We're already approaching the station.

lines.zh: 这两个数字很接近。
lines.py: zhè liǎng gè shù zì hěn jiē jìn .
lines.en: These two numbers are close.

lines.zh: 她在门口等待朋友。
lines.py: tā zài mén kǒu děng dài péng you .
lines.en: She waits for her friend at the entrance.

lines.zh: 等待的时候，我们聊了一会儿。
lines.py: děng dài de shí hou , wǒ men liáo le yī huì er .
lines.en: We chatted while waiting.

lines.zh: 火车八点到达北京。
lines.py: huǒ chē bā diǎn dào dá běi jīng .
lines.en: The train arrives in Beijing at eight.

lines.zh: 我到达以后给你打电话。
lines.py: wǒ dào dá yǐ hòu gěi nǐ dǎ diàn huà .
lines.en: I'll call when I arrive.

lines.zh: 我得走了，还要赶车。
lines.py: wǒ děi zǒu le , hái yào gǎn chē .
lines.en: I need to leave; I have a bus to catch.

lines.zh: 为了赶时间，他没吃早饭。
lines.py: wèi le gǎn shí jiān , tā méi chī zǎo fàn .
lines.en: He skipped breakfast to save time.

lines.zh: 我八点以前赶到了车站。
lines.py: wǒ bā diǎn yǐ qián gǎn dào le chē zhàn .
lines.en: I reached the station before eight.

lines.zh: 她终于在开门前赶到了。
lines.py: tā zhōng yú zài kāi mén qián gǎn dào le .
lines.en: She finally arrived before the doors opened.

lines.zh: 她前后一共来了三次。
lines.py: tā qián hòu yī gòng lái le sān cì .
lines.en: She came three times in all.

lines.zh: 我十点前后能到。
lines.py: wǒ shí diǎn qián hòu néng dào .
lines.en: I can arrive around ten.

lines.zh: 你慢慢吃，我不着急。
lines.py: nǐ màn màn chī , wǒ bù zháo jí .
lines.en: Take your time eating. I'm in no hurry.

lines.zh: 天慢慢亮了。
lines.py: tiān màn màn liàng le .
lines.en: It slowly grew light.

lines.zh: 我一直记得那个时刻。
lines.py: wǒ yì zhí jì de nà gè shí kè .
lines.en: I've always remembered that moment.

lines.zh: 她拍下了朋友到家的时刻。
lines.py: tā pāi xià le péng you dào jiā de shí kè .
lines.en: She photographed her friend's moment of homecoming.

lines.zh: 出门时记得带钥匙。
lines.py: chū mén shí jì de dài yào shi .
lines.en: Remember your keys when you go out.

lines.zh: 他笑时眼睛很亮。
lines.py: tā xiào shí yǎn jīng hěn liàng .
lines.en: His eyes shine when he smiles.

lines.zh: 她打破了学校的跑步纪录。
lines.py: tā dǎ pò le xué xiào de pǎo bù jì lù .
lines.en: She broke the school's running record.

lines.zh: 这个纪录十年没人打破。
lines.py: zhè gè jì lù shí nián méi rén dǎ pò .
lines.en: No one has broken this record for ten years.

lines.zh: 我想把这段歌录下来。
lines.py: wǒ xiǎng bǎ zhè duàn gē lù xià lái .
lines.en: I'd like to record this passage of the song.

lines.zh: 她把这些名字一个个录入表里。
lines.py: tā bǎ zhè xiē míng zi yī gè gè lù rù biǎo lǐ .
lines.en: She entered these names in the table one by one.

lines.zh: 我在录音里听见了你的声音。
lines.py: wǒ zài lù yīn lǐ tīng jiàn le nǐ de shēng yīn .
lines.en: I heard your voice in the recording.

lines.zh: 这段录音的声音太小了。
lines.py: zhè duàn lù yīn de shēng yīn tài xiǎo le .
lines.en: This recording is too quiet.

lines.zh: 这一期杂志我已经看过了。
lines.py: zhè yī qī zá zhì wǒ yǐ jīng kàn guò le .
lines.en: I've already read this issue of the magazine.

lines.zh: 这期课程月底结束。
lines.py: zhè qī kè chéng yuè dǐ jié shù .
lines.en: This course ends at the end of the month.

audio.zh: 从下周起，周二和周四晚上六点半上课。
audio.py: cóng xià zhōu qǐ , zhōu èr hé zhōu sì wǎn shang liù diǎn bàn shàng kè .
audio.en: From next week, Tuesdays and Thursdays at six thirty in the evening.

tasks.statement: Classes are on Tuesday and Thursday evenings at six thirty.
tasks.why: This heard line explicitly supplies the information.

audio.zh: 回家路上，我们约好周四还是六点十五分见。我把时间写进手机，又把游泳的东西放回包里，这次不用到出门前才找。
audio.py: huí jiā lù shàng , wǒ men yuē hǎo zhōu sì hái shi liù diǎn shí wǔ fēn jiàn . wǒ bǎ shí jiān xiě jìn shǒu jī , yòu bǎ yóu yǒng de dōng xi fàng huí bāo lǐ , zhè cì bù yòng dào chū mén qián cái zhǎo .
audio.en: On the way home we arranged the same six-fifteen meeting for Thursday. I put the time in my phone and the swimming things back in my bag, so I would not have to search just before leaving.

notes:
AI-assisted draft; native review pending. GF2021 grammar families: 三39, 三52. Native check: 初 lunar-date prefix versus the later first-arrival adverb lesson, elapsed-time double-了 constructions, 前后 sequence versus approximation, 纪录 versus 记录, 将近 boundaries, 期 magazine classifier and original verse rhythm. Native review pending. Planned retrieval 三30 / 三70 / 三34 / 三68: 要是时间合适，就再问她。, 只有她同意，才写她的职业。, 她不慌不忙地核对地址。, 好是好，不过地点还没确认。.
2026-10-07 parity editorial review: Earlier HSK 3 naturalness correction: a classmate helps with a small article, friends choose a rainy-day film venue, a photo makes a bridge look close, and two adults start swimming lessons. Removed identity/privacy/assessment cautions and report-like conversation. All target words have independently authored contexts instead of being stuffed into speech. Formed six text questions and nine or ten mixed tasks from the actual new facts while keeping all old IDs. Native flags: colloquial teasing about tickets and photos; 大主语/小主语 description; 好是好，就是; time-from 起 and elapsed 了; 精神 jīngshén as spirit versus the earlier energetic jīngshen; 录 as a bound verb in 录入; realistic descriptions of a first swimming class. Native review pending; no independent pronunciation or learner-mastery certification.
